en-US.description: Private, local-first desktop app for cleaning up and organising photos, videos, music, and documents.
en-US.longDescription:
MediaMango is a private, local-first desktop app for cleaning up and organising photos, videos, music, and documents. Everything runs on this device — no account, no server, no uploads.
Features include Autosort, photo & video duplicate detection, media compression, lossless audio checking, and custom folder organisation.
en-US.name: MediaMango
